decisions.reason: The margin analysis builds on the established offer and has its own page, a visible commitment that fits the announced platform strategy, so management will persist.
The gas tariff comparison is close to the core market-data business and is publicly presented, so it cost little to run and dropping it would require justification.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is core to the firm's tariff offering and has a page of its own, so management stays committed to it.
The multi-model product line represents substantial investment, but it is only mentioned on the website and partly overlaps with C, which makes consolidation somewhat more likely.
The area definition tool supports the location-based applications on the central platform and is visibly presented, so the firm keeps it.
This product line with several models is close to the established offer and represents sunk investment, though its low website visibility leaves some chance it is merged into other products.
